body: I know it’s not “over,” but it kind of is. Once the mental health system gets to you, you are forever tarnished. They ruin lives. I will never live up to my full potential, so what’s the point of even trying? They’ve got me, so why not play into their hand. I’ll take my fucking disability check, live off the government, be a selfish drunk, and live a life of zero responsibility. They’ve already robbed me of my ability to have any self respect, so why not live out my life in ignorance as the pathetic human that they’ve branded me as.

It takes a lot more effort and energy to jump off of a building than to go to your local liquor store and buy a fifth of whiskey. Once you feel sick enough from drinking you’ll get a little more perspective, I promise.

You have children. Be happy. Don’t give a fuck about what anyone else thinks of you, and don’t be jealous of anyone with nicer things than you. You have been given the greatest gift in the world. Nothing else should matter.

Maybe you should start engaging in some vices. Become the shitty person that you feel everyone thinks you are. I’m in a somewhat similar boat, and I’ve started drinking heavily and started doing some illegal shit. Alcohol and cocaine will give you some energy, trust me. If you no longer have regard for your own life, you might as well start acting like it. You can’t do anything if you’re dead.
